capabilities.name: program_change_scenes
capabilities.implementation: Program Change channel message parser/serializer and scene memory Bulk Dump/Request envelope; program-to-scene assignment table payload remains opaque.

capabilities.name: assignable_control_change
capabilities.implementation: Control Change channel messages and C assign-table Bulk Dump/Request envelope; table entries are preserved as opaque bytes.

capabilities.name: parameter_change
capabilities.implementation: AW2816 Yamaha digital-mixer envelope, MIDI channel/mode/type, and the known type identifiers 00, 01, 02, 10, 40, 41 and 43. Addresses and value payloads are retained without semantic guesses.

capabilities.name: bulk_dump_and_request
capabilities.implementation: LM  8C36 Yamaha universal bulk envelope; known data names M/S/R/Q/Y/E/T/H/A/P/C; selector validation; byte-count and documented two's-complement 7-bit checksum verification. Opaque data is retained.
manual_references: Appendix p. 406 section 4.13.2 and checksum paragraph

capabilities.name: midi_remote
capabilities.implementation: Remote-memory R request/dump envelope and selectors for banks A-D; payload remains opaque.

capabilities.name: mmc
capabilities.implementation: Recognizes unambiguous AW2816 MMC commands 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 40 and 44. The tool does not transmit MMC. Reset commands 0D and 0F are excluded and recorded separately as a manual conflict.

capabilities.name: mmc_reset
capabilities.implementation: unsupported; parser emits ambiguous_mmc_command for either byte and preserves all raw bytes; no serializer or backup request can emit either command.
capabilities.required_confirmation: hardware observation or authoritative Yamaha specification

capabilities.name: mtc_and_song_position_pointer
capabilities.implementation: Parses MIDI Time Code Quarter Frame (F1) and Song Position Pointer (F2); does not generate timing or synchronize audio.
manual_references: Owner's Manual pp. 188-191, MTC OUT connector

capabilities.name: automix
capabilities.implementation: A Automix memory Bulk Dump/Request envelope and documented selector range; Automix event payload remains opaque.

capabilities.name: midi_clock_generation_and_sync
capabilities.implementation: No MIDI Clock generation, outgoing sync, or audio synchronization is implemented.

capabilities.name: unmapped_parameter_addresses_and_payload_fields
capabilities.implementation: No parameter addresses or undocumented payload field meanings are assigned. Bytes remain available verbatim in parser output and archives.
manual_references: Appendix pp. 410-412 sections 4.13.3.2-9 define encodings but do not supply a complete semantic map used by this foundation

capabilities.name: host_midi_port_pairing_by_name
capabilities.implementation: Backup tries an exact-name paired output port for the selected input; --output-port overrides the pairing. It does not establish physical cable topology.
manual_references: Not an AW2816 protocol fact; validate the adapter's port names during hardware commissioning
